description: This file contains React components for displaying Decentralized Identifiers (DID) in various formats: inline, compact card, detailed view, and badge. It includes functions for copying DID to clipboard, truncating DID display, and uses custom icons and hooks related to DID info.

methods.name: DIDDisplay
methods.description: Main component for displaying a DID in various styles based on the 'variant' prop.

methods.name: DIDIdentityBadge
methods.description: A compact badge component that shows verification status and DID snippet.
